events.verdict: Hachimura (LAL) initiates contact with Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) arm/wrist and affects his shot attempt.
Smart (LAL) dislodges the ball from Embiid (PHI).
James (LAL) brushes Edgecombe's (PHI) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) is moves alongside Reaves' (LAL) path as he defends the drive.
Grimes (PHI) initiates contact with Reaves' (LAL) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Klebler (LAL) and Embiid (PHI) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Edgecombe (PHI) establishes himself in Smart's (LAL) path prior to the contact.
James (LAL) moves alongside Maxey's (PHI) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Edgecombe (PHI) deflects the ball away from Smart (LAL).

Edgecombe (PHI) avoids making body contact with Smart (LAL) as he begins to dribble up the court.  However, Grimes (PHI) delivers body contact that affects Smart's SQBR.  While a foul is correctly called on this play, the foul should have been assessed to Grimes.
Kleber (LAL) moves alongside Maxey's (PHI) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Edgecombe (PHI) legally contests Hachimura's (LAL) shot attempt.
Hachimura (LAL) legally contests Maxey's (PHI) jump shot.  Any contact is created by Maxey as he moves towards Hachimura during his upward shooting motion.
